title: Updated Nationally Determined Contribution of the Republic of Uzbekistan
organization: Government of the Republic of Uzbekistan; UNFCCC repository
temporal_coverage: Historical warming since the early 1950s; NDC adaptation planning through 2030 and projections through 2050.
methodology: Government NDC with interagency climate and adaptation planning.
limitations: Official assessment; not an implementation evaluation.

title: Climate Action Could Accelerate Growth and Improve Living Standards in Uzbekistan: World Bank Group Report
temporal_coverage: CCDR release gives population risk estimates to 2030 and economic projection to 2050.
methodology: World Bank Group press-release summary of the Uzbekistan Country Climate and Development Report.
limitations: Only the official release was inspected; it does not reproduce all report model assumptions or uncertainty ranges.

title: ATLAS of socio-economic and environmental indicators in the Aral Sea region of Uzbekistan
organization: United Nations Development Programme; Institute for Social Research
temporal_coverage: 2017 household and focus-group survey; Atlas published 2019.
methodology: Excluded at coordinator review because the publicly hosted document is marked for internal use only.
limitations: No substantive findings from this document are retained in the research intake or candidate bank.

title: Karakalpakstan Agriculture Risk Profile for Climate Resilience Capacity Development
temporal_coverage: Four-district climate-resilience risk profile published March 2025; assessment period not specified in the publisher summary.
methodology: GGGI risk profile summarizes climate-resilience factors and vulnerability findings for four target districts in Karakalpakstan.
limitations: Only the substantive publisher summary was accessible; it omits sample design, indicator construction, and district-specific breakdowns.

title: Water and conflict in Central Asia
geographic_coverage: Amu Darya and Syr Darya basins
temporal_coverage: Review published in 2025; assesses regional water/conflict evidence, including 1990-2024 and future prospects.
methodology: Twelve-page research synthesis compares six water-scarcity metrics and reviews regional climate, water, and conflict evidence.
limitations: Conflict evidence is regional, not Uzbekistan-specific; scarcity-conflict causality is debated.

title: UNDP in Uzbekistan and Uzhydromet sum up the results of joint activities on developing climate resilience of farming communities in Karakalpakstan
organization: United Nations Development Programme; Center of Hydrometeorological Service of Uzbekistan (Uzhydromet)
temporal_coverage: Adaptation Fund project implemented 2014-November 30, 2021; closeout results announced November 2021.
methodology: UNDP-Uzhydromet project-closeout announcement reports equipment, service reach, and uptake figures presented at the final coordination meeting.
limitations: This is a project announcement, not an independent evaluation; beneficiary counts may overlap and the page provides no comparison group or measured impact estimates.

title: From local knowledge to local action: Communities shape restoration in three regions of Uzbekistan
organization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
geographic_coverage: Lower Amu Darya State Biosphere Reserve
temporal_coverage: FAO-reported field visits and community workshops, including June 2026 consultations.
methodology: FAO account summarizes field assessments, June 2026 workshops, participant proposals, and visits to candidate restoration sites under FOLUR-Uzbekistan.
limitations: The page reports consultation findings and proposals, not a sampled vulnerability study, implemented restoration outcomes, or an independent evaluation.
